fact: The Ministry of Natural Resources and Energy says the Deeds Registry has computerised its land, debts and miscellaneous contract registers since 1995, updated daily as ownership changes hands, with scanned records on-line on a local network.
system: Deeds Registry computerised registers and imaging system

fact: Kenya's State Department for Lands reports that Registrar of Deeds Nozipho Vilakati said Eswatini is working to upgrade its manual registration and storage of deeds into a fully electronic system, after two benchmarking visits to Kenya's Ardhisasa.
